# A Million Followers Is a Rented Institution — finished platform kit

## 1. LONG
Begin with a seven-digit counter; remove it layer by layer until only access, records, permissions, and routes remain.

## 2. SHORT 01
Followers are reach. They are not automatically contact permission, customer records, or recovery control.

## 3. SHORT 02
The five-minute account continuity drill: owner, admin, recovery, originals, alternate route.

## 4. CAROUSEL
Reach; access; data; permission; archive; route; recovery; next action.

## 5. WORKSHOP
Complete the portability map without downloading or repurposing personal data beyond consent.

## 6. NEWSLETTER
Pair the argument with an account-recovery checklist and a plain-language privacy note.

## Claim ledger
- **INFERENCE:** A platform account is governed by platform access and recovery systems, not possession of the audience itself. (S32, S36)
- **PROPOSAL:** An owned contact channel and exportable records reduce—but do not eliminate—platform dependency. (S08, S39)

## Publication discipline
Do not add unlicensed imagery. Preserve captions, alt text, creator and institution credits, canonical URLs, and evidence labels. Legal analysis is issue-spotting, not legal advice.
